ClubHero.title: THE CLUB
ClubHero.description: An MMA fighter management agency born in Dakar, to give Senegalese fighters the means to go further.

history.title: Born from a conviction
history.p1: Los Leones was born from a simple observation: Senegal is full of talented fighters, but too few of them have access to real career support.
history.p2: The agency was founded to fill that gap — scouting talent, preparing it seriously, and opening doors that fighters could not have opened alone.

vision.title: Taking Senegalese MMA higher
vision.p1: To become the reference in MMA fighter management in West Africa, recognized for the standard of its support and the integrity of its method.
vision.p2: Every Leone we represent should be able to focus on one thing: fighting at the highest level, while the agency takes care of the rest.

AgentHero.p1: Founder of Los Leones, Sidy Ndiaye built his path around a simple conviction: talent is not enough, you also need the right structure to break through in MMA.
AgentHero.p2: After years of watching the lack of serious support offered to Senegalese fighters, he founded Los Leones to fill that gap — scouting talent, preparing it, and opening doors that fighters could not have opened alone.
AgentHero.p3: Today, he is the direct point of contact between the fighters represented by the agency and the MMA ecosystem — promoters, sponsors, partner gyms.
